notice-el27-11-comment-period.point: PJM asked for a four-week extension, to December 21, 2026, to answer the Exelon complaint, and opposed fast-track processing.
notice-el27-11-comment-period.quote: On November 4, 2026, PJM Interconnection, L.L.C. (PJM) filed a preliminary answer opposing fast-track processing and a motion requesting a four-week extension of time, until December 21, 2026, to answer the complaint filed by Exelon Corporation (Exelon)

notice-el27-11-comment-period.point: PJM says it wants to include the outcome of its Board's November 17, 2026 deliberations in its response.
notice-el27-11-comment-period.quote: PJM argues that there is good cause to grant the extension because the additional time will permit PJM to incorporate into its response the outcome of the deliberations by the PJM Board, which will meet on November 17, 2026.

notice-el27-11-comment-period.point: FERC grants the extension and sets December 21, 2026 as the deadline.
notice-el27-11-comment-period.quote: notice is hereby given that PJM’s motion for extension of time is granted and the deadline to file the answer to Exelon’s complaint, comments, and interventions is December 21, 2026.

answer-el27-11-exelon-extension.point: Exelon says PJM's proposed extension is excessive for the narrow scope of the allegations it must answer.
answer-el27-11-exelon-extension.quote: the scale of PJM’s proposed extension is excessive for the narrow scope of the allegations it must answer.

answer-el27-11-exelon-extension.point: Exelon says it should not take PJM 48 days to state its view on the narrow legal question.
answer-el27-11-exelon-extension.quote: it should not take PJM 48 days to express its opinion on this narrow legal question.

answer-el27-11-exelon-extension.point: Exelon supports extending the comment period to December 7, 2026, which gives PJM 34 days after the complaint.
answer-el27-11-exelon-extension.quote: Exelon supports an extension of the comment period until December 7, 2026, which will provide PJM with a total of 34 days after Exelon filed the complaint

answer-el27-11-exelon-extension.point: Exelon says the relief it seeks is prospective and can be given only before the auction process moves forward.
answer-el27-11-exelon-extension.quote: the relief Exelon seeks is prospective, and it can be meaningfully provided only before the auction process moves forward.

complaint-el27-11-exelon.point: Exelon asks FERC to replace the three-year forward period with a prompt auction starting with the 2030/2031 Delivery Year.
complaint-el27-11-exelon.quote: the just and reasonable replacement rate a “prompt” auction schedule

complaint-el27-11-exelon.point: Exelon asks for fast track processing and a January 1, 2027 refund date, with an order by January 31, 2027.
complaint-el27-11-exelon.quote: establish a refund effective date of January 1, 2027, and permit Fast Track processing under Rule 206(h) to facilitate a Commission order by no later than January 31, 2027

complaint-el27-11-exelon.point: The complaint leaves the 2029/2030 auction in December 2026 and any Reliability Backstop Procurement auction untouched.
complaint-el27-11-exelon.quote: nothing in this complaint is intended to apply to, or otherwise disrupt the implementation of, the 2029/2030 Delivery Year BRA, which is scheduled to run in December 2026

complaint-el27-11-exelon.point: Exelon says the 2027/2028 and 2028/2029 auctions cleared at the price cap while falling thousands of MW short of the reserve margin target.
complaint-el27-11-exelon.quote: the 2027/2028 and 2028/2029 Delivery Year BRAs clearing at the temporary Commission-approved price cap and simultaneously falling thousands of MWs short of PJM’s target Installed Reserve Margin.

complaint-el27-11-exelon.point: Exelon says forecasts four years ahead structure uncertainty into prices, which large load volatility worsens.
complaint-el27-11-exelon.quote: it produces market outcomes that charge customers on the basis of parameters estimated four years in advance of delivery completion, thereby structuralizing uncertainty and inaccuracy with no proportional benefit.

complaint-el27-11-exelon.point: Exelon concedes the prompt auction will not cure all of RPM's problems.
complaint-el27-11-exelon.quote: the targeted surgery requested in this complaint will not heal all that ails RPM.
